params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter orders by the specified fields.

Filter semantics: `filter[field][operator]=value`.

Available filter operators:
- `eq` - equal (=)
- `gt` - greater than (>)
- `gte` - greater than or equal (>=)
- `lt` - less than (<)
- `lte` - less than or equal (<=)

Filtering is allowed by the following fields:
  - `status` (`eq`)
  - `order_number` (`eq`)
  - `po_number` (`eq`)
  - `customer_id` (`eq`)
  - `authorized_at` (`eq`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`)
  - `amount_authorized` (`eq`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`)
  - `amount_captured` (`eq`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`)
  - `amount_canceled` (`eq`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`)
  - `amount_remaining` (`eq`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`)

Example: `filter[status][eq]=authorized`

Note: filter with the `eq` operator is equivalent to `filter[field]=value`
